**Sundhedsklynge Bornholm** is a local healthcare cluster operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src4] [^src6]. It is one of the many regional health clusters evaluated in the Danish national quality reports monitoring the treatment and management of [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. The cluster's performance is systematically tracked across multiple clinical quality indicators to assess local variations in care, benchmark practices, and evaluate patient outcomes across the Danish healthcare system.

In terms of specific clinical metrics, Sundhedsklynge Bornholm achieved a 91.0% result for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] for newly diagnosed patients [^src1]. However, the cluster did not meet the required standard for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which evaluates the use of echocardiography as a diagnostic tool, recording a result of 78.1% [^src2]. Furthermore, data from the period between July 1, 2018, and June 30, 2019, shows that the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients receiving anticoagulation treatment in the cluster was 80.0% [^src4]. 

The cluster is also included in broader national analyses, such as the geographic distribution of stroke (apopleksi) incidence mapped under [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] [^src5]. Its data is consistently benchmarked against other regional clusters to support hierarchical quality improvement strategies [^src3] [^src5]. Additional ongoing monitoring for the cluster includes long-term treatment coverage [^src3] [^src4], annual laboratory measurements [^src5], and the incidence of severe bleeding and heart failure within the first year of diagnosis [^src7] [^src8].
